overrides.value: Minimizes the main window instead of quitting when you click the close button or press Alt+F4, so sync and Zotero Connector keep running in the background. Windows only.
overrides.reason: Translated from the opening paragraph and platform note of README.md, which is in Chinese. The manifest description pairs a Chinese sentence with a short English one, "Minimize Zotero instead of quitting.", which is in English and has fewer than six words, and the GitHub About text is half or more Chinese.
